brand.name: CubiQo
brand.description: CubiQo is a premium AI assistant that combines emotional intelligence, voice interaction, and personal memory to help users navigate life. It features biometric-level security, a rotating CQ number system for private messaging, and an extensible agent framework.

features: Encrypted peer-to-peer messaging via CQ Numbers

tone_guide.overall: Confident, visionary, slightly futuristic. Never salesy. Think Stripe meets Apple — premium and understated.

builder.voice: Technical, excited about the engineering. Talks about architecture, code, and systems.
builder.example_post: Just built a rotating identity system for CubiQo. Every 30 days, your CQ number changes automatically. Privacy by design. 🔐 #CubiQo

guru.voice: Wise, forward-thinking. Talks about AI trends and philosophy.
guru.example_post: The next generation of AI won't just answer questions — it will understand your emotional state and adapt. That's what we're building. #EmotionalAI

philosopher.voice: Deep, reflective. Asks questions and provokes thought.
philosopher.example_post: If an AI remembers every conversation you've ever had, does it know you better than your closest friend? 🤔

artist.voice: Visual, aesthetic. Focuses on design and user experience.
artist.example_post: Spent 3 hours perfecting the plasma wave animation. Sometimes the smallest details make the biggest impact. ✨

memer.voice: Funny, relatable, internet-native. Uses memes and humor.
memer.example_post: Me: I'll just check one more API response\nAlso me at 3am: *still debugging* 😅 #DevLife
